standard_prerequisites.name: Tor groups commute with filtered colimits of modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows transferring the vanishing from each R[f^n]-quotient stage to the colimit R/R[f^infinity].

core_obligations: Rewrite the quotient as R/R[f^infinity] = colim R/R[f^n] = colim f^nR (proof line 25492). Since Tor^R_1 commutes with filtered colimits (proof lines 25493-25495), we get Tor^R_1(R', R/R[f^infinity]) = colim Tor^R_1(R', f^nR). Each term vanishes by the glueing-pair lemma for the first Tor (proof line 25495), so the colimit vanishes and Tor^R_1(R', R/R[f^infinity]) = 0 (proof line 25496).
proof_roadmap: Rewrite R/R[f^infinity] as a filtered colimit of the modules f^nR (proof line 25492).
Commute Tor past the colimit and apply the first-Tor lemma to each stage (proof lines 25493-25496).
difficulty_reason: 5 行、glueing pair 的 Tor_1 消没：把 R/R[f^∞] 改写为滤过 colim f^nR；Tor 与滤过 colim 交换把问题化为各阶段 Tor_1(R', f^nR)；由 glueing pair 的 first-tor 引理每项为 0，故 colim 为 0。承重两步（colim 改写、Tor 交换）都在 span 内；2 处引用作导航桩。
